verses.1: I have chosen a name that is worth far more than gold and silver. It’s a good name indeed.
verses.2: The rich and the poor met together; all of them were created by Jehovah.
verses.3: They saw evil and darkness; they were trapped and trapped in a situation where they couldn’t escape.
verses.4: Because of the fear of Jehovah, there will be prosperity, honor, and life.
verses.5: They will be weighed in the balance; their souls will be separated from them.
verses.6: He was trained in accordance with his own ways, and even though he grew up, he was still not allowed to leave that place.
verses.7: A man who is rich in trees will be poor, and his servant will become a slave to someone else.
verses.8: This is a short description of Avla Yiktsar-Aon, and his rule over Ebreta can be understood from this.
verses.9: A good eye will bless him, for it gives him the ability to fight.
verses.10: He went out of the den, and he sat down in Din and Klon.
verses.11: He who loves with a pure heart, whose words are kind and gentle.
verses.12: The eyes of the LORD were sharp, and they saw everything clearly; thus, the words of the prophets were revealed.
verses.13: And Asel Ari said, “In the wilderness, amidst the vastness of the land.”
verses.14: May his mouth be sealed, and may his tongue be restrained from speaking. May Jehovah destroy him there.
verses.15: Eulath Kshurah, with a heart full of sorrow, is a bearer of bad news that brings us away from here.
verses.16: He gives wealth to those who deserve it, but he also gives it to the rich.
verses.17: Be attentive to what the wise say, and let your heart be ready to understand my words.
verses.18: For they will be kept safe in your womb, together on your lips.
verses.19: To be in the Lord’s presence, you must know today that even you are already among them.
verses.20: I have written to you with advice and knowledge.
verses.21: To inform you, I will speak the truth, so that you may also speak the truth.
verses.22: Do not steal from those who are poor and need help. Do not cause the poor to suffer in the streets.
verses.23: For Jehovah will make them fight against each other, and He will settle their disputes.
verses.24: Do not harm the man of Apha; and do not let his beloved ones enter.
verses.25: Do not make your guests suffer, and do not burden your soul with such things.
verses.26: Do not be like those who are trapped in the wilderness, with nothing to eat.
verses.27: If you don’t want to pay, then why should he take something from your bed?
verses.28: Do not cross the boundaries of a world that your ancestors created.
verses.29: A man who is swift in his actions will stand before kings; he will be honored in front of those who are powerful.
